question: Does any single tightening of the SPIKE V12.9 5m exit (selected on OKX ETH ordinary trades before 2025-10-10) raise mean net R after 0.2% round-trip cost on both OKX ETH 5m last twelve months and Binance ETH 5m 2021-09-25..2024-01-31, and is the gain specific to the signal versus matched random entries?
single_variable: Exit rule only. Entries, sides, entry prices, initial stops and recorded opposite-signal exits are frozen from the parent ledgers; candidates only tighten protection or scale out earlier (spike_exit_giveback.POLICIES).
owner_approval: 2026-10-10 owner chose option 3 (5m exit single-variable test), which changes barrier parameters under study only; no Pine, monitor, preset or account change.
selection: Among non-incumbent candidates, the highest mean net R on OKX ordinary signal trades signalled before okx_split; it must beat the incumbent there, otherwise nothing is selected.
pass_rule: Selected candidate: mean net R minus incumbent > 0 on OKX last twelve months and on Binance 2021-09..2024-01 ordinary signal trades, and pooled validation paired sign-flip p < 0.01 (two-sided). Joint trades and matched controls are reported, not used for selection.
